title.zh: 修订第1411号共和国法第3条若干项目的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Certain Items of Section Three of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven
title.orig: An Act Amending Certain Items of Section Three of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1468_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item twenty, under Negros Occidental school buildings, subsection ai. of section three, page five hundred twenty-four, of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, is amended to read as follows:
"20. Eusebio Memorial School Building, Sagay—Construction ₱5,000.00 "20a. Campo Himogaan Primary School, Sagay 5,000.00 "20b. Makiling Barrio School, Sagay 5,000.00 "20c. Completion and Painting of Himogaan Barrio Home Economics School Building, Sagay 3,000.00 "20d. Completion and Painting of Barrio Bato Primary School Building, Sagay 2,000.00"

Item twenty-four, page five hundred twenty-four of the same Act, is amended to read as follows:
"24. Barrio Plaridel Primary School Building, Sagay ₱5,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 14, 1956.
